territories.name: Kyrgyzstan
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Kyrgyzstan levies a value added tax of its own under the Tax Code of 18 January 2022, No. 3: article 254 sets it at 12 per cent of the taxable supply and the taxable import and at 0 per cent for the supplies of articles 302 to 306, articles 264 to 296 exempt the supplies they list, and the tax period is the calendar month (article 313).
